job: แปลงจัดสรรกระจุกอยู่ที่ไหน และรอบแปลงมีหมู่บ้านแบบไหน — แล้วเจาะลงถึงอำเภอ รายการจัดสรร โครงการ กรอบพื้นที่และอาคาร หลักฐาน และสถานี
audiences: ทีมพัฒนาโครงการแนวราบที่หาทำเลถัดไป
เจ้าของที่ดินและนักลงทุนที่ประเมินแปลง
ผู้ประเมินมูลค่าและสถาบันการเงิน
ผู้ประกอบการค้าปลีกและบริการที่ตามชุมชนบ้านจัดสรร
journey: province (districts as chips, projects on the map)
district (plots by type, rank and share in the province, records, projects)
project (extent and lit buildings in 3D, labels and price as shown, paired records, legal entities, company reports, station)
record (plots by type, scope, allocator, DOL address and page)
charts (provinces, plot types, districts) and the record table
basedOn: CityMETER · University 0.1.5 (montri-th/university @f610edb, citymeter-shell 0.6.2), itself from School 0.6.0 and Hotel: every engine contract (camera, basemap, massing, x-ray, terrain, building units, breadcrumb, partial notice, phone sheet, English) is carried unchanged; the campus extent and its lit buildings become the estate extent and its lit buildings (owner 2026-11-18). This release ships citymeter-shell 0.6.3 (Housing Estate in the dataset picker).

rowScopes.scopeRows: district rows after the plot-type filter, before the province selection: the base of the national Aha, the province fill, the province chart
rowScopes.baseRows: scopeRows narrowed by the selected province: the province Aha, district chips and ranks, the plot-type bars, the district chart, the table
rowScopes.rows: projects under house type · search · province: pins, labels, lists; records under the same filters: the table and the district view

firstAha.scope: whole country (no province selected); a selected province switches to its districts
firstAha.ranking: provinces by the measure; at most three, never cutting through a tie, never every province holding the measure (js/area-insight.js#topWithoutTie)
firstAha.headlineTemplate: <pct> ของแปลงจัดสรรทั้งประเทศ อยู่ใน <N จังหวัดนี้> · province: <pct> ของแปลงจัดสรรใน<จังหวัด> อยู่ใน <N อำเภอนี้>
firstAha.numerator: Σ measure of the focused provinces (or districts)
firstAha.denominator: Σ measure of scopeRows (or of the province)
firstAha.secondaryFinding: the same share among house plots only (detached + semi-detached + row) as a second bar with both bases (plots, no type filter); the provinces with no record under the filters by name
firstAha.action: ดูทุกจังหวัดเท่ากัน · เปรียบเทียบจังหวัด (charts) · select a province
firstAha.filter: the Aha follows the plot-type filter; house type and search narrow the projects only (tests/insight.test.js)
fallbacks: one item alone is its own finding
no record under the filters → the provinces named as measured zero

words.plots: แปลงจัดสรร · แปลง
words.records: รายการจัดสรร · รายการ

countingUnitContract.rule: the map, legend, labels, Aha, ranks and charts read the same measure; a project never carries a figure of its own

metricContract.areas: production districts (395 hold a record): chips with the measure in the chosen province, never outlines
metricContract.provinces: Σ measure per province of the records production counts there
metricContract.eligibility: none (totals; tie rule of the Aha)
metricContract.combined: never adds projects to records; a pair is shown as a pair; the house-plot comparison narrows numerator and denominator alike
metricContract.ramp: all 41 LUT samples by rank among the measured nonzero provinces (and among the districts of the chosen province for the chips)

coverageContract.covered: 19,753 records in 395 districts of all 77 provinces; 1,538 projects (798 pins, 139 extents) from 65 publishers; 373 pairs; 301 stations

states.measuredZero: a province or district without a record under the filters: outline, no fill, listed by name
states.noPoint: a project without a drawn pin: listed with its developer, district and province, chip “ไม่มีจุดบนแผนที่”
states.noExtent: a project without an extent: the pin and its surroundings, no “กรอบราว”
states.fileMissing: partial notice per optional file (extents, portfolio, records); the measure stays complete

categoricalCueContract.rule: no star; plot types are parts of the measure, never given a house-type series

framesContract.index: data/area-index.json (77 provinces, districts with production codes and English names)
framesContract.frames: data/provinces.geojson only; district outlines are read at build time (a pin’s district), never shipped; districts are chips at their label points
framesContract.loading: with the first paint, beside data/estates.json
framesContract.failure: partial notice (“กรอบจังหวัด”); the panel figures stay complete

mapFocusContract.principle: focus + quiet context: detail for the focus only, everything else visible but quiet

states.country: province fills, Aha provinces outlined, project pins by house type
states.province: the selected province filled, the others outline-only; its districts as chips with the measure; its projects as pins
states.district: framed on its box from the area index (plan, maxZoom 13); its province filled, its projects as pins
states.project: model preset on the extent; the drawn buildings in the extent lit (map.activeLayer); extents of the other projects dashed
states.building: two-point camera; x-ray of the building looked at

mapFocusContract.choropleth: province fill to zoom 10.5 (li.supply | count, 41 samples); measured zero = outline

contextContract.rail: CityMETER · Transit stations (operating: quiet clickable rings; under construction: words only); nearest within 2 km per pin at build time

contextActionsContract.ai: Google Search with a question written for the view (/search?q=)
contextActionsContract.maps: Google Maps search by public names
contextActionsContract.dataBoundary: Google’s answers are Google’s: never copied into the data

buildingJoinContract.buildings: the focus massing (CityMETER Building V4 or OpenStreetMap per building unit)
buildingJoinContract.points: the interior point of each drawn building piece, tested against the open project’s extent (js/extent-buildings.js)
buildingJoinContract.rule: a drawn building with a piece inside the extent (outside its holes) is lit whole in map.activeLayer; js/shell/building-join.js#joinBuildings is given no points of its own
buildingJoinContract.click: a lit building opens “อาคารในกรอบโครงการ” with “สูงราว N ม.” and the two-point camera
buildingJoinContract.neverChanges: plots, records, pairs or the measure; lit buildings are never counted on screen

interactionContract.mapClicks: pin → the building being looked at (x-ray) → lit building → station → estate extent → province
interactionContract.reframe: every way into a project or a building frames it again
interactionContract.chips: a district chip opens the district; a province chip opens the province
interactionContract.keyboard: roving tabindex over HTML pins, arrow keys on the measure switch and the chart tabs, visible focus everywhere

basemapContract.palette: --basemap-* tokens of assets/theme.css; data colours never set there

massingContract.cityTier: basemap building extrusions, quiet, faded with distance from the focus
massingContract.focusTier: rounded footprints from z14 tiles in the focus regions (building, station square, estate extent and its surroundings, camera square), bounded per device budget
massingContract.enclosure: encloseOffsetM keeps the rounded shape around the original outline
massingContract.buildingSource: data/building-units/ (copied from montri-th/university @f610edb: the Hotel units plus the อปท. round the campuses)

presets.plan: pitch 0 (3D off; country, province and district fits)
presets.model: pitch 60 · fov 14 (project framed on its extent and surroundings)

cameraContract.fitting: fitPitched: flat fit, then zoom out until every vertex is inside the padded viewport; country maxZoom 7; a district maxZoom 13 (area-index box); a project maxZoom 17 / minZoom 11
cameraContract.phone: model above the open sheet for a project; tiltWhenNear after the reader’s own move

venueXrayContract.visibility: 3D only, zoom ≥ 13, the building being looked at

breadcrumbContract.provinceCodes: production route codes (base info lv0 abbrEn)

provinceContract.fill: the measure to zoom 10.5; the selected province filled, the others outline-only
provinceContract.labels: chips with the measure to zoom 10; district chips in the chosen province from zoom 7 to 13.5 (at most 40)

pictogramContract.meanings: js/navigation.js#PICTOGRAM_CONTRACT: area = แปลงจัดสรร, เขต/อำเภอ and the estate extent · dataset = รายการจัดสรร and the provenance dataset · province = จังหวัด · segment = ประเภทแปลง/ประเภทบ้าน · maps = โครงการบนแผนที่ · building = ผู้พัฒนา and a drawn building · aff = นิติบุคคลและบริษัทแม่ · history = รายงานประจำปีของบริษัท · fee = ราคาเริ่มตามหน้าเว็บ · date · ai · rail · compare · terrain (sea, elevation, relief, forest) · rank · distance · construction
pictogramContract.rule: decorative (aria-hidden); the text carries the meaning; no star

panel.models: js/profile-model.js (buildOverview, buildDistrictProfile, buildSiteDetail, buildCompanyProfile, buildRecordProfile, buildStationProfile, buildBuildingProfile, buildSearch)
panel.provenance: one line per view: dataset · source · date · boundary, then วิธีนับ (DATA_METHOD.md)
panel.phoneSheet: peek · half · full below 761 px in portrait

data.checks: meta.checks (plot types add up; province coverage equal; production lv0 equal)

englishContract.names: provinces and districts from the area index, stations from nameEn, plot and house types, scopes, labels, pin roles, pair levels, legal roles and event classes from the data files; projects, brands, Thai-named publishers, allocators and DOL record names stay Thai
englishContract.check: a harvest of every view (window.__citymeterI18n.missing empty) before a release

visualSystem.themes: light and dark; analytical HEX identical on both
visualSystem.fonts: Bai Jamjuree · IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped · Arvo · JetBrains Mono (assets/lds/build-kit)

invariants.rule: plots are the records’ own, counted in the production district and province of the record; never allocated to a project, a pin, an extent or a building
records and projects are never added; a pair is shown as a pair of a record and a project, named by how the research team found it; held pairs stay out
a project carries no plot figure — never 0
a province or district without a record under the filters is a measured zero (outline, no fill) and is listed by name
the Aha never cuts through a tie and never focuses every item holding the measure
every share shows numerator and denominator; the house-plot comparison shows both bases in each bar
labels, starting prices and launches are what the source showed; a price is never compared, averaged or ranked; a label is never a sales status
house types bind to LDS series by id with their shape cue; plot types are neutral bars, never a series; no star
colour scales use all 41 LDS samples by rank, identical HEX on both themes
every panel view ends with exactly one provenance line and carries no caveat
no Google Maps coordinates, review statuses, researcher notes, private links, sheet addresses or credentials in the tree
an allocator is named only when its name carries a legal-entity form
distances are straight lines between reference points
lit buildings are the drawn buildings in the open project’s extent, never counted and never the whole focus
